mapper.sql: drive_id, user_id, client_drive_id::text AS client_drive_id, status, started_at, ended_at, observed_seconds, distance_meters, inattention_count, drowsiness_count, route_simplified::text AS route_json, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM drives WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND client_drive_id = #{clientDriveId}::uuid
SELECT FROM drives WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO drives (user_id, client_drive_id, status, started_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{clientDriveId}::uuid, #{status}, #{startedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE drives SET status = 'ABANDONED' WHERE drive_id = #{driveId} AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS'

UPDATE drives SET status = 'ENDED', ended_at = #{endedAt}, observed_seconds = #{observedSeconds}, distance_meters = #{distanceMeters}, inattention_count = #{inattentionCount}, drowsiness_count = #{drowsinessCount}, route_simplified = #{routeJson}::jsonb WHERE drive_id = #{driveId}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO drive_events (drive_id, event_type, detected_at, latitude, longitude) VALUES
(#{driveId}, #{e.eventType}, #{e.detectedAt}, #{e.latitude}, #{e.longitude})
ON CONFLICT (drive_id, event_type, detected_at) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO drive_waypoints (drive_id, place_id, place_name, place_type, latitude, longitude, nav_mode, trigger_type, added_at, visited, visited_at) SELECT #{driveId}, p.place_id, p.name, p.place_type, p.latitude, p.longitude, #{navMode}, #{triggerType}, #{addedAt}, #{visited}, #{visitedAt} FROM rest_places p WHERE p.place_id = #{placeId} AND p.latitude IS NOT NULL

INSERT INTO drive_hourly_stats (drive_id, user_id, hour_start, observed_seconds, inattention_count, drowsiness_count, distance_meters) VALUES
(#{s.driveId}, #{s.userId}, #{s.hourStart}, #{s.observedSeconds}, #{s.inattentionCount}, #{s.drowsinessCount}, #{s.distanceMeters})
mapper.select: SELECT event_id, drive_id, event_type, detected_at, latitude, longitude FROM drive_events WHERE drive_id = #{driveId} ORDER BY detected_at, event_id

SELECT waypoint_id, drive_id, place_id, place_name, place_type, latitude, longitude, nav_mode, trigger_type, added_at, visited, visited_at FROM drive_waypoints WHERE drive_id = #{driveId} ORDER BY added_at, waypoint_id
